prompt:
Desktop resume website, edge to edge, no browser chrome. The whole screen is one tower's curtain wall at night. Only one office bay is lit with tungsten light, and that single bay is cropped by the left and right edges so it is the ground of the page. Every other pane is dark blue glass. Do not light a whole floor.

Etched into the lit glass, monumental frost-white grotesque, tight tracking: MOHD SOHEL DESHMUKH. On the same glass: Senior Software Engineer, Biz4Solutions, April 2025 – Present, Pune. Top edge, etched links: Home, Work, Contact. A pressable frost-glass button on the lit bay reads deshmukh.sohel@yahoo.com.

The bottom band is darker glass, the start of the next section, one line only: Senior Programmer, Biz4Solutions, April 2022 – June 2025. Do not invent any other years or roles. No 2021, no 2019.

Blue-black glass, one warm bay, frost type cut into the glass. A working page with navigation and an email button, not a poster and not a left-column layout.
